verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a public Lambda Cloud API of REST endpoints for creating and managing cloud resources, published as an OpenAPI spec at cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json. The docs show programmatic instance launch with cloud-init and custom base images, plus webhook notifications. A community-built CLI and MCP server that launches and terminates instances through this API independently confirms it works; the probe 404s only cover docs.lambda.ai paths, not the live spec location. Missing for 10: evidence that the API covers 1-Click Clusters, filesystems and firewalls (which are documented only via UI pages), and documentation of authentication, rate limits or SDKs.
